authorship: Project-authored teaching overlap; not an upstream copy or validated disease preset
implementation_basis: TextbookEcgTables.P, divided by its exact Q32 maximum and multiplied by each requested signed microvolt amplitude with Int128 ties-to-even rounding
timing: Both components trigger from AtrialElectrical. SeparationPermille=0..499, default375 (old3/8). Late delay=round-even(Pduration*separation/1000); both durations=Pduration-delay. Reject duration<=delay or a nonzero requested separation rounded to zero. Zero separation permits coincident lobes. Default preserves previous tables and timing.
projection: Ten electrode entries; null keeps reference P, explicit zero pair removes its P. Standard limb/Wilson projection follows.
limitations: Overlap fractions are authoring choices, not textbook measurements. No separate right/left atrial chamber interpretation, disease classification, P-axis model or normality assertion. Component amplitudes are not final lead peaks.
